profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Penske Media Corporation
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Publishing Team
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer and educator. At Penske Media, I lead platform engineering for the Publishing Engineering Team -- four engineers supporting 20+ editorial brands including Rolling Stone, Billboard, and Variety, where a bad deploy is visible to millions of readers.
 
I care most about the seam between design and engineering: getting interfaces to match their intent, keeping systems maintainable as they grow, and making complicated things feel simple. I've spent a decade teaching that craft as well as practicing it. As a lecturer at USC, I've taught web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, PHP, SQL) to over 1,400 students, with an average course rating of 4.83/5.
 
The work I'm proudest of is teaching web development to young women in Afghanistan through USC's partnership with HerFuture Afghanistan -- helping open doors where access to education is limited.

Whatever I'm building, mentoring others and collaborating with kind, smart people is my favorite part of the job.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Publishing Team
positions.description:
Penske Media is a digital media company that owns and operates leading entertainment and publishing brands including Billboard, Rolling Stone, Variety, Golden Globes, and SXSW.

- Tech Lead for the Publishing Engineering Team, owning platform engineering across 20+ properties on enterprise WordPress VIP — shared infrastructure, release process, and architecture decisions for a small, high-leverage team.

- Led Apple News integration across PMC's brand portfolio, including ANF templating, image bundling, and content sync — extending editorial reach to a major distribution channel.

- Led development on sponsorship-driven features and microsites for high-profile brands, directly contributing to multi-million dollar revenue campaigns.

- Built a Laravel-based internal CRM application to manage publisher partner data for events, improving organization, tracking, and outreach for editorial and partnership teams.

- Mentor engineers through code review, technical design feedback, and internal documentation.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
After teaching part-time for 2 years while working full-time as a web developer, I joined the USC faculty full-time in Fall 2017. Teaching web development courses to students from all fields of study. I welcome both newbies to coding who want to learn a new skill as well as experienced students who want to level up their game.

Courses Taught:
- ITP 104: Web Publishing
- ITP 115: Programming in Python
- ITP 301: Interactive Web Development
- ITP 303: Full-Stack Web Development

Topics taught: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, relational database design, SQL, PHP, MVC, Laravel, Bootstrap, WordPress, Sass

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
Specialties: UX Engineering, Responsive web design, Web animations, WordPress development

Recent projects:
- Official website of actress Jennette Mccurdy (www.jennettemccurdy.com). Built in Sass and lots of CSS animations.
- American In Justice (https://www.american-in-justice.com/) by Variety & Rolling Stone. Used CSS Grid for the first time.
- Edwin, a desktop application for Nelson, Canada's leading educational publisher. Built in React, wrapped around Electron.

positions.title: Part-time Lecturer
positions.description: I benefited so much from ITP as a student and this was my opportunity to give back. Taught evening classes while holding down my day job.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I happily develop interactive web experiences for entertainment consumers with the amazing team here at space150. Developing applications and creating solutions for major entertainment producers such as Disney, Universal, and Fox.

+ Languages/tools used on a daily basis: Javascript, HTML, CSS, Sass, git, jenkins, Photoshop, Avocode
+ Currently tinkering with: Angular2, nodeJS, gulp

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: TA for Introduction to Web Technology courses. Learning to not only explain complex technical concepts to non-technical majors, but also learning to debug and read bad code while grading and helping with students' work.

honors.title: Valedictorian
honors.description: Hard work pays off -- worked my butt off in high school and graduated first in my class.
honors.issuer: Issued by Imperial High School · Jun 2010
